name: Diego Hernandez
bio:
Diego Hernandez is a rising star in motorsport operations, fueled by a lifelong passion that ignited during his childhood visits to the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. Though relatively new to the professional scene, Diego possesses a sharp analytical mind and a relentless drive to optimize performance. His early experiences volunteering at local racing events instilled in him a deep appreciation for the intricate coordination required to run a successful motorsport team.

As head of operations, Diego is committed to streamlining processes and fostering a culture of efficiency and accountability. He believes in empowering his team members to take ownership of their roles while providing them with the necessary resources and support to excel. He is already developing a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to quickly identify and resolve potential issues before they escalate. 

 Diego's demanding nature stems from his unwavering commitment to excellence and his belief that even the smallest improvements can make a significant difference on the track. He is eager to learn from experienced professionals and contribute his unique perspective to a winning team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Diego is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.
